name: Lymphedema Staging, Lymphoscintigraphy, and Microsurgical Restoration

reference.source: Sabiston Textbook of Surgery 22nd ed / Rutherford Vascular Surgery 9th ed
clinicalPearls: Stemmer sign (inability to pinch skin at base of second toe) is pathognomonic for lower limb lymphedema
Primary lymphedema includes Milroy disease (congenital), Meige disease (praecox), and lymphedema tarda
Technetium-99m sulfur colloid lymphoscintigraphy is the gold standard diagnostic imaging investigation
Complete decongestive therapy (CDT) is the foundational conservative treatment for all clinical stages
Supermicrosurgical lymphovenous anastomosis (LVA) diverts lymphatic fluid into subdermal venules in early stages
reference.pathophysiology: Lymphedema arises from congenital hypoplasia or secondary obliteration of lymphatic channels. Interstitial macromolecular protein accumulation elevates oncotic pressure, attracting free water and triggering chronic T-cell-mediated inflammation, fibroblast activation, adipocyte hypertrophy, and irreversible non-pitting collagenous fibrosis of the dermis and subcutis.
additionalDifferentials: Chronic venous insufficiency with dependent edema (pitting, hemosiderin)
Congestive heart failure / bilateral systemic cardiac edema
Lipidema (bilateral symmetric fat accumulation sparing feet; Stemmer sign negative)
additionalInvestigations: Bioimpedance spectroscopy to detect subclinical extracellular fluid increases
Magnetic resonance lymphangiography (MRL) for lymphatic anatomical visualization
